facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A family was on a ship in a storm. The ship broke apart! But the family stayed together. "The family worked together."
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Robinson family was sailing to a new country when a terrible storm hit. The ship started to break apart, and all the sailors escaped in lifeboats. Only the family was left behind on the sinking ship! Father told everyone not to give up because they had each other. "The family worked together." Being together gave them the strength to survive.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The Robinson family — father, mother, and four young sons — were sailing across the ocean to start a new life. Without warning, a violent storm struck their ship with devastating force. As the vessel began to break apart, the terrified crew abandoned ship in the only lifeboats available. The family found themselves completely alone on a sinking ship in the middle of a raging sea. "The family worked together." However, the father refused to let despair overtake his family in this desperate situation. Because they trusted each other and worked as a team, they managed to survive the terrifying night. This first crisis proved that family unity would be their greatest weapon against whatever challenges lay ahead.
facts.Word cards: survival = 생존 / together = 함께 / storm = 폭풍 / island = 섬
